symptom: `mxcli fix widgets` on macOS with an 11.12.2 project failed: mx update-widgets 'Project is in different Mendix version - 11.12.2' (exit 4). The same project and command worked in a Linux container with --mx pointing at MxBuild's mx.
file: cmd/mxcli/cmd_fix.go runFixTool / resolveFixMx; cmd/mxcli/docker/check.go LocalMxForVersion. Test: cmd/mxcli/fix_mx_resolve_2321_test.go
cause: runFixTool resolved mx with docker.ResolveMxForVersion, which treats the project's version as a preference: an mx on PATH comes first, then the newest Studio Pro install or any cached mx. update-widgets and rename-design-properties only work on their own version, so any fallback is a guaranteed failure.
insight: **For a tool that edits the project in its own version's format, the version is a requirement, like `mxcli new` (ResolveMxForNewProject), never a preference.** resolveFixMx takes an explicit --mx as given, else an exact-version local mx, else (Linux) downloads that version, else (macOS/Windows, where the CDN's Linux mx cannot run) refuses naming the version and the --mx route. Not measured on macOS (none here): the fix is the resolution order, tested by injected lookups; on Linux an 11.12.6 project still resolves the cached 11.12.6 mx and fix widgets runs. The issue's other half — `replace <pluggable widget> with` writing a stale definition (CE0463) — did not reproduce with stock pluggable widgets (combo box, pop-up menu replaced inside a container on 11.12.6: no CE0463); it needs the tester's dropdown-menu widget.
